mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.tracking_no,s.carrier,s.status,s.shipped_at,s.delivered_at,o.order_no,e.event_type,e.occurred_at,e.location FROM shipment s JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=s.order_id LEFT JOIN shipment_event e ON e.shipment_id=s.id WHERE s.tracking_no=#{trackingNo} ORDER BY e.occurred_at,e.id

SELECT s.id,s.tracking_no,s.carrier,s.status,s.shipped_at,s.delivered_at,o.order_no,o.customer_id FROM shipment s JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=s.order_id WHERE s.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY s.shipped_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT s.id,s.tracking_no,s.carrier,s.status,o.order_no,s.shipped_at,s.delivered_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,s.shipped_at,s.delivered_at) delivery_hours, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_event e WHERE e.shipment_id=s.id) event_count FROM shipment s JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=s.order_id WHERE o.customer_id=#{customerId} OR o.address_id IN (SELECT a.id FROM customer_address a WHERE a.customer_id=#{customerId}) ORDER BY s.shipped_at DESC,s.id DESC

SELECT x.shipment_id,x.tracking_no,o.order_no,x.event_type,x.occurred_at,x.location FROM (SELECT e.shipment_id,s.tracking_no,s.order_id,e.event_type,e.occurred_at,e.location, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.shipment_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC,e.id DESC) rn FROM shipment_event e JOIN shipment s ON s.id=e.shipment_id) x JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=x.order_id WHERE x.rn=1 AND o.customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY x.occurred_at DESC,x.shipment_id DESC

SELECT s.id,s.tracking_no,s.carrier,s.warehouse_id,o.order_no,o.ordered_at,s.delivered_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,o.ordered_at,s.delivered_at) total_hours FROM shipment s JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=s.order_id WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,o.ordered_at,s.delivered_at)>#{hours} ORDER BY total_hours DESC,s.id LIMIT 100

WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS ( SELECT DATE(#{from}) UNION ALL SELECT d+INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM days WHERE d+INTERVAL 1 DAY<DATE(#{until})) SELECT d.d day, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment s WHERE DATE(s.shipped_at)=d.d) shipped_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment s WHERE DATE(s.delivered_at)=d.d) delivered_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_event e WHERE DATE(e.occurred_at)=d.d) event_count FROM days d ORDER BY d.d
